meta.title: 꼬마 화가
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (꼬마 화가, a picture-book app (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: The brief asks for the basic crayon box on yellowed drawing paper: paper #F7EFDC, a soft charcoal ink #34323C, and the box itself (red #E2483A, orange #F2952B, yellow #F6C33B, green #58A846, sky #68B6E8, blue #3E7FD0, purple #8B5CC4, pink #EF7BA5, brown #8A5A2E). Each sentence takes one crayon.
rationale.type: Gaegu, a handwritten Korean face, at 60-250 px: letters pop on one at a time with a slight tilt that settles, and they sit in the crayon layer, so the paper tooth breaks them like everything else.
rationale.motion: Hand speed: every mark is drawn on along its own path (three thin offset passes per line, zig-zag scribbles for fills), the lines boil at 8 fps like hand-drawn animation, a crayon stick rides the line being drawn; pages slide up like a sketchbook and the drawing shrinks into a book.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 112 BPM in F major (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s) on ukulele, marimba and bells with a light kit; organic SFX: a crayon drawon for every mark, pops for the letters, a page flip.
rationale.visuals: Everything is code: the paper (fibres, a fixed tooth), the crayon marks, the drawing (hills, a house, a tree, a child with a kite, the sun, clouds, flowers), the book and its turning pages. No images.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, music-led launch reel; every sentence is on screen.
